summary: Static technical audit against expanded file (scripts/expand-md.js) + four compendiums (platform_and_boundaries, research_claims, prompts, pedagogy technical subset). Both platform claims independently re-verified live 2026-07-10 (WebFetch): the /goal slash command exists and matches its described syntax; the Ralph bash one-liner is a verbatim, correctly-dated, correctly-attributed quote of Huntley's 2025-07-14 post. Sole citation (ghuntley.com/ralph/) carries a correct [practitioner direct] label, correct 6-month-freshness caveat, and a valid freshness stamp. Registry prompt agents-that-build-agents-handoff.md is mechanically clean (canonical shape, no placeholders, correct back-reference chain, verified warm session across the M6 closer chain, correct label). Three non-blocking findings: (1) the /goal capability claim lacks its own in-file freshness stamp in the Source-verification block -- already self-flagged by the maintainer's own 'Open for next pass' TODO, independently confirmed accurate; (2) the handoff-prompt fence has no explicit grill-before-save close, though the surrounding body's judgement/push-back framing may substitute by design; (3) the historical Ralph quote names a binary (claude-code) that differs from today's CLI invocation (claude) -- low risk given clear historical framing and no Prompt-widget chrome. All three quality-stamp SHAs verified as real ancestor commits of current HEAD. No blocking findings. Supersedes the prior technical@6ab470b instance recorded in this file (narrower ~9-rule ledger, predates the slides/emphasis passes) with a full one-entry-per-compendium-rule ledger per the completeness contract.
